annotations.title: x402 payment requirements + pay URL for a paid Avasis route

description: Return the x402 payment requirements of a paid route (price, accepts[] with amount/asset/payTo/network, the pay URL with your inputs filled in, the free sample and the also_available ladder) so YOUR OWN x402 wallet can pay the HTTP route and read the answer. This server never holds or spends funds. Free.

input.description: the route's inputs, e.g. {"mint": "<base58 mint>"}, {"q": "bitcoin"}, {"url": "https://..."}, {"gas_limit": 65000}; omit to get the template with placeholders

product.description: product key from avasis_products, e.g. solVerdict, solCompleteKit, pmCompleteKit, pmMarkets, webRead, evmGasOps, tip_eth_gas
